seed.description: random seed: another number is another arrangement with the same rules

cellSize.description: edge of the streamed cells: cells near the camera are scattered, far ones dropped; unit: m

model.description: the model scattered (not for grass); content path of a model asset (no extension)

height.description: blade height (times the scale); unit: m

width.description: blade width at the root (times the scale); unit: m

lean.description: how far the tip leans, in blade heights

grass.description: scatter grass blades instead of a model: one triangle each, merged into one mesh per cell

material.description: material of the grass blades (double-sided, wind mode grass); content path of a material asset (no extension)

cellSize.description: edge of this layer's cells; unset uses the file's (grass: 16); unit: m

density.description: at most this many per hectare (100 × 100 m)

slope.description: only where the ground slope is in this range; unit: °

height.description: only where the ground height is in this range; unset is anywhere; unit: m

scale.description: size of the patches; unit: m

coverage.description: 0..1: how much of the ground the patches cover

clump.description: scatter in patches instead of everywhere

avoidPaths.description: keeps this far off the roads and rails the terrain follows (and out of its flatten features); unit: m

scale.description: random uniform scale in this range

alignToSlope.description: 0 stands upright (trees), 1 lies along the slope (rocks)

sink.description: pushed this far into the ground (times the scale); unit: m

viewDistance.description: scattered only this close to the camera; unit: m

distance.description: cells farther than this from the camera use this level; unit: m

model.description: a simpler model (e.g. the same tree without its finest level); unset keeps the nearer one; content path of a model asset (no extension)

keep.description: keeps this fraction of the points (thinner grass far away); unset keeps the nearer level's

impostor.description: draws the nearer level's model as a camera-facing card baked at runtime (far trees)

lods.description: levels of detail by distance, nearest first

layers.description: layers of placement rules, each scattering one model
